hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite UI files or VERSION.
root_entry: public/index.html redirects to the permanent online live entry
v037_issue: In v0.3.6 the full dashboard was already rendered but progress could remain at 72.000% because non-critical enhancement scripts were still on the blocking critical path.
v037_fix: Core completion is based on full-recovery producing at least 8 real dashboard sections.
After core completion progress becomes 100.000% and the loading panel fades then display:none after about 420ms.
evaluation/phase/ui/layout/returns/cycle-history load after the core screen and no longer block the progress bar.
Optional scripts have a 4-second timeout and cannot revert a completed core screen to loading.
Native Android Back bridge is defined inline before optional enhancements.
performance_rules: Compounder TradingView charts remain lazy-loaded only after unfold and viewport approach.
1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y returns come from one public/data/compounder-returns.json request, not 76 client Yahoo requests.
Stale cache purge occurs only once per release.
Core rendering and optional analytics must remain separated.

cycle_history.warning: Historical averages are descriptive comparisons, not a forecast of the next turning date.

android_back_contract: Open detail/modal -> hardware Back closes it.
must_preserve: compounders grouped by theme/rank with weekly charts and 1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y returns
real load percent + progress bar + exact failure stage
qa: At least 8 major sections causes core success without waiting on optional scripts.
The loading panel disappears after success.
Optional script delay/failure does not leave the UI stuck at 72% or another intermediate value.
